name: CSN 109 冰雹风挡裂 自动降落许可

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CSN 109, you are approaching VYK, maintaining 4500 meters, squawking 3125, make initial contact with Beijing Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 CSN 109，正接近 VYK，保持 4500 米，应答机 3125，与北京管制首次联系。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN 109, approaching VYK, maintaining 4500 meters, squawking 3125.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN 109，接近 VYK，保持 4500 米，应答机 3125。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 109, Beijing Control, radar contact, direct to VYK, after passing VYK, climb to 8400 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 109，北京管制，雷达识别，直飞 VYK，过 VYK 后爬升至 8400 米。
cards.referenceText: Direct to VYK, after passing VYK, climb to 8400 meters, CSN 109.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞 VYK，过 VYK 后爬升至 8400 米，CSN 109。

cards.audioText: B: Your weather radar observed a thunderstorm ahead, request Beijing Control for a right turn to avoid the thunderstorm.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的气象雷达观察到前方雷暴，请求北京管制右转避开雷暴。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN 109, our weather radar observed a thunderstorm ahead, request right turn to avoid it.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN 109，我们的气象雷达观察到前方雷暴，请求右转避让。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 109, negative due military activity, turn left heading 010.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 109，不能同意，因军事活动，左转航向 010。

cards.audioText: B: Now there is a strong E of thunderstorm, you are too close to the weather, request left turn to avoid it.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在有强雷暴回波，你离天气太近，请求左转避让。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN 109, there is a strong E of thunderstorm, we are too close to the weather, request left turn to avoid it.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN 109，有强雷暴回波，我们离天气太近，请求左转避让。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 109, left turn is not permitted due restricted area.
B: Suddenly, you have suffered from hail strike, the wind shield is cracked on the outside, report it to Beijing Control and request return to land.
cards.audioTextZh: B：突然，你遭遇冰雹撞击，风挡外层开裂，向北京管制报告并请求返回着陆。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN 109, we have suffered from hail strike, the wind shield is cracked on the outside, request return to land.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN 109，我们遭遇冰雹撞击，风挡外层开裂，请求返回着陆。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 109, roger, turn right heading 340, direct to VYK, descend to and maintain 5100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 109，收到，右转航向 340，直飞 VYK，下降并保持 5100 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 340, direct to VYK, descend to and maintain 5100 meters, CSN 109.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 340，直飞 VYK，下降并保持 5100 米，CSN 109。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 109, descend to 4200 meters, contact Beijing Approach 119.25.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 109，下降至 4200 米，联系北京进近119.25。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are maintaining 4200 meters, over VYK, you have got information K, contact Beijing Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你保持 4200 米，在 VYK 上空，已收到通播 K，联系北京进近。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CSN 109, maintaining 4200 meters, over VYK, information K.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，CSN 109，保持 4200 米，VYK 上空，通播 K。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 109, Beijing Approach, radar contact, follow VYK-05 arrival, expect radar vectors for ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 109，北京进近，雷达识别，执行 VYK-05 进场，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 36R。
cards.referenceText: Follow VYK-05 arrival, expect radar vectors for ILS approach Runway 36R, CSN 109.
cards.referenceTextZh: 执行 VYK-05 进场，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 36R，CSN 109。

cards.audioText: B: During approach, neither of you can see through the windshield due to a cracked windshield, you ask Beijing Tower if Beijing Airport permits auto-land.
cards.audioTextZh: B：进近中，由于风挡开裂，你们两人都无法透过风挡看清，询问北京塔台北京机场是否允许自动着陆。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CSN 109, neither of us can see through the windshield due to a cracked windshield, does your airport permit auto-land?
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CSN 109，由于风挡开裂，我们两人都无法透过风挡看清，你机场是否允许自动着陆？

cards.audioText: C: CSN 109, Runway 36R, cleared to land, surface wind 350, 3 meters per second.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 109，跑道 36R，可以落地，地面风 350，3 米/秒。

cards.audioText: B: After landing, you can't see the taxiway clearly due to cracked windshield, request a tug.
cards.audioTextZh: B：落地后，由于风挡开裂，你看不清滑行道，请求拖车。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CSN 109, we can't see the taxiway clearly due to cracked windshield, request a tug.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CSN 109，由于风挡开裂，我们看不清滑行道，请求拖车。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 109, hold position, the tug will come soon.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 109，原地等待，拖车很快会来。
